summary.text: Ryan Wilcox is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 7 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He served in the House from 2009 to 2014 and returned in 2021, and has worked as a policy advisor to U.S. Senator Mike Lee.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Wilcox was born in Ogden, Utah, and earned a bachelor's degree from Weber State University in 2008.
His career experience includes business management in the telecom and healthcare sectors and work as the Northern Utah director and senior policy advisor to U.S. Senator Mike Lee.
Wilcox has been affiliated with the Ogden School Foundation, Follow the Flag North Ogden, and Scouts, BSA.
Wilcox represented Utah House District 7 from 2009 to 2014 and has represented the district again since 2021, succeeding Kyle Andersen.
